verdict.rationale: Lockfile enforcement is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence documents Brewfiles and `brew bundle check`, which only reports whether the installed state already satisfies the Brewfile. Nothing shows a lockfile or a frozen/immutable mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce a frozen/immutable lockfile mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree
